parsed.rationale: Both participating records live in test targets: one in 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' (package: Metadata) and the other in 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift' (package: app:iOS). Although the context flags do not set is_test=true, the file paths unambiguously place both declarations inside test bundles (the 'Tests/' directory segments and the 'Tests' package suffixes). The type 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver.MockError' is a nested mock error type used as a test fixture in two separate test suites that exercise different formatters/parsers; the duplication is intentional so each test module remains self-contained. Extracting this type to a shared location would couple two otherwise independent test targets and risk leaking test-only semantics into production or shared code.
